turns.user: I need published mortars with drying shrinkage no more than 600 microstrain at 28 days and compressive strength of at least 50 MPa.
turns.text:
I’ll search the literature database for mortars meeting both limits and check the reported test ages.
The strict age check narrowed the results, and some retrieved entries have an expansion-versus-shrinkage sign issue. I’m checking the source notes before listing the qualifying mortars.
**GOS50 and J3 meet both limits in the literature database; CA120 is a conditional match because of a reported-unit ambiguity.** I assumed the compressive-strength requirement also applies at 28 days.

These are published UHPC mixtures classified as mortars in the database—not demonstrated printable mixes.

| Published mix | Drying shrinkage at 28 d (microstrain) | Compressive strength at 28 d (MPa) | Composition / source |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| **GOS50** | **574** | **120.03** | Portland cement, silica fume, waste glass and oyster-shell powders; w/b 0.18. [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jobe.2024.109833) |
| **J3** | **411** | **109.4** | Portland-cement UHPC mortar from a study of shrinkage-reducing and expansive admixtures; w/b 0.20. [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1155/2017/6384859) |
| **CA120 — conditional** | **203*** | **89** | Portland cement, calcium aluminate cement, silica fume and fly-ash microspheres; w/b 0.18. [Paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jobe.2024.111672) |

*CA120’s database extraction interprets an apparent unit typo as microstrain. Verify the original shrinkage units before selecting it.*

The values above are extracted published measurements, not predictions. Shrinkage exposure conditions and the age reference should be checked against your intended protocol; specimen geometry and curing were not standardized across this search. No curing or specimen defaults were imposed.

input.sql: SELECT m.paper_uid, m.mix_uid, m.name_in_paper, m.w_b_reported, m.sand_binder_ratio, s.value_canonical AS shrinkage_microstrain, c.value_canonical AS strength_MPa, s.condition_note AS shrinkage_condition, s.source_locator AS shrinkage_source, s.fig_only AS shrinkage_fig, c.source_locator AS strength_source, c.fig_only AS strength_fig, t.geometry, m.curing_regime FROM mixes m JOIN measurements s ON s.mix_uid=m.mix_uid JOIN measurements c ON c.mix_uid=m.mix_uid LEFT JOIN tests t ON t.test_uid=c.test_uid WHERE m.system_type='mortar' AND s.quantity='drying_shrinkage' AND c.quantity='compressive_strength' AND CAST(NULLIF(s.age_norm_d,'') AS REAL)=28 AND CAST(NULLIF(c.age_norm_d,'') AS REAL)=28 AND s.unit_canonical='microstrain' AND c.unit_canonical='MPa' AND CAST(NULLIF(s.value_canonical,'') AS REAL) BETWEEN 0 AND 600 AND CAST(NULLIF(c.value_canonical,'') AS REAL)>=50 ORDER BY m.paper_uid,m.name_in_paper
